method: HWM water surface (STN, NAVD88) minus 3DEP ground at the mark vs surveyed height above ground; quality <= 4

street_level_only.excluded: marks described as basement/ramp/stair/inside/below grade (water pooled below street level)

note: All-marks misses are basement/ramp seed lines: water pooled below street grade, measured against a basement floor, while 3DEP is street-level ground. Those produce no street observation (unknown, never dry). Street-level subset is the fair test.
